title: The Netflix profile
premise: Daughter says she's studying for exams; Mummy notes Netflix on the shared account shows episode 9, and Mummy is only on episode 4, so no spoilers.

script.text: Netflix says you are on episode 9. Papa and I are on episode 4, so no spoilers.

caption: no spoilers mumma

post.caption: The Netflix account is shared and so is the evidence. Send this to your mumma before she sends it to you.
